title: Ashfall: Progression
summary: Upgrade in stable steps without skipping the safety layer.

blocks.title: Widen The Safe Loop
blocks.body: Progression is not distance first. It is reliability first: filtration, storage, route marks, basic power, hazard counters, and enough carrying capacity to bring the upgrade materials home.

blocks.title: Filtration Tier
blocks.body: Filters and purification are the first range upgrade. Better water lets you turn one nervous trip into two calm trips.
blocks.label: Filter Workbench
blocks.subtitle: Water progression station

blocks.title: Power Tier
blocks.body: Once water is stable, power decides whether base work stays manual or becomes infrastructure. Repair the smallest useful network before chasing bigger stations.
blocks.label: Scrap Dynamo
blocks.subtitle: Starter power source

blocks.title: Do Not Skip The Middle
blocks.body: The middle step can feel boring because it is the safety layer: markers, meters, storage, backups, and known exits. Build that layer before raising the risk.
